notes.title: Update P1 （new map new Leveling up mechanism and more）
notes.notes:
Update P1
 
New Additions
1. Add a new map and introduce new difficult enemies.

 

 

2. Introduce an upgrade mechanism, changing the game mechanics.
[p align="justify"] 

Killing zombies and cyborgs can increase combat experience.

Leveling up allows for skill points, improving weapon performance, or enhancing personal abilities.

There are nearly 20 types of skill points to choose from, enhancing weapons, melee combat, scavenging, and survival skills.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"] 

3. Increase the randomness of the map, with all enemies and supplies randomized according to difficulty.

Every gameplay has variations in enemy positions and numbers, maintaining overall balance.

 

 
Improvements
 

1. Introduce new weapons.

 

2. Adjust and enhance the shooting performance and feel of most weapons.



3.Modify and balance the enemies in the first level.
